decisions.decision: The 200-foot setback in 4.16.7 will be edited so the Board may waive it if it renders an otherwise viable parcel unusable.
decisions.quote: section will be edited to note that if the 200 foot setback renders an otherwise viable parcel unusable, the board may waiver the 200 foot setback.

decisions.decision: Section 4.16.4.2 will be revised to include processing.

decisions.decision: Cultivation will be changed to Commercial and Office Park/Industrial by special permit.
